build.buildCommand: node --version && corepack --version && corepack yarn@3.5.0 --version && corepack yarn@3.5.0 install --immutable && corepack yarn@3.5.0 build

deploy.startCommand: cd tracker_development && PYTHONPATH=.. python manage.py migrate && PYTHONPATH=.. python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && PYTHONPATH=.. daphne -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT tracker_development.asgi:application
